relationships.subject: electrical stimulation
relationships.evidence_quote: ES at this condition also enhanced the expression of the genes encoding myelin basic protein (MBP) and myelin-associated glycoprotein (MAG), which are essential for assembling myelin sheath.

key_findings: Electrical stimulation at 20 Hz for 1 h reduced intracellular PMP22 aggregation in a CMT1A Schwannoma cell model.
Stimulation enhanced MBP and MAG expression and altered Krox-20, Oct-6, c-Jun and Sox10.
